definitions.gloss: direct rays; direct sunlight; shining directly
definitions.explanation: Light or sunlight that strikes directly without being diffused, reflected, or filtered. Most commonly used for direct sunlight.

definitions.gloss: direct fire; direct hit; point-blank shot
definitions.explanation: Shooting or firing directly at a target in a straight line, as opposed to indirect or arced fire.

notes:
Composed of {直|ちょく} (direct/straight) + {射|しゃ} (shoot/radiate). Most frequently encountered in the compound ⟦{直射日光|ちょくしゃにっこう}→直射日光：15044_chokushanikkou⟧ (direct sunlight).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{直射日光|ちょくしゃにっこう}→直射日光：15044_chokushanikkou⟧: direct sunlight
- ⟦{直射日光|ちょくしゃにっこう}→直射日光：15044_chokushanikkou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{避|さ}ける→避ける：02109_sakeru⟧: to avoid direct sunlight
- {直射|ちょくしゃ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to shine directly; to fire directly
- {直射|ちょくしゃ}{砲|ほう}: direct-fire gun

USAGE:
Sense 1 is far more common in everyday life. The phrase ⟦{直射日光|ちょくしゃにっこう}→直射日光：15044_chokushanikkou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{避|さ}けて→避ける：02109_sakeru⟧⟦{保管|ほかん}→保管：11442_hokan⟧ (store away from direct sunlight) appears on countless product labels and packaging in Japan.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{日差|ひざ}し→日差し：00107_hizashi⟧: sunshine, sunlight — general word for sunlight, not necessarily direct
- ⟦{間接|かんせつ}→間接：00180_kansetsu⟧: indirect — the opposite concept; {間接照明|かんせつしょうめい} means indirect lighting
